question_en: The slope of the tangent line to $y=x^3$ at $x=2$ is
question_uz: $y=x^3$ grafigiga $x=2$ nuqtada o'tkazilgan urinmaning og'masi nechaga teng?

explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. y' = 3x², x = 2 da 3·4 = 12.

question_en: A particle moves along the $x$-axis with $x(t)=5t^2$ (meters, seconds). Its speed at $t=3\ \mathrm{s}$ is
question_uz: Zarra $x$ o'qi bo'ylab $x(t)=5t^2$ (metr, sekund) qonun bo'yicha harakatlanadi. $t=3\ \mathrm{s}$ dagi tezligi qancha?
question_ru: Частица движется вдоль оси $x$ по закону $x(t)=5t^2$ (метры, секунды). Чему равна её скорость при $t=3\ \mathrm{s}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. v = dx/dt = 10t, t = 3 s da 30 m/s.
Asos: tezlik — koordinatadan hosila.

distractors_en.A: this is the acceleration ($10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$), not the velocity

question_en: A mass oscillates as $x=A\cos\omega t$. Its maximum speed is
question_uz: Yuk $x=A\cos\omega t$ qonun bo'yicha tebranadi. Uning maksimal tezligi qancha?
question_ru: Груз колеблется по закону $x=A\cos\omega t$. Чему равна его максимальная скорость?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. v = −Aω sin ωt, |sin| ≤ 1 ⇒ v_max = Aω.
Asos: v = dx/dt, zanjir qoidasi.

distractors_ru.B: это максимальная координата, а не скорость

distractors_en.B: this is the maximum displacement, not the speed

question_en: At a local maximum of a smooth function $f(x)$,
question_uz: Silliq $f(x)$ funksiyaning lokal maksimum nuqtasida quyidagilardan qaysi biri bajariladi?
question_ru: Что выполняется в точке локального максимума гладкой функции $f(x)$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Ekstremumda f' = 0; maksimumda grafik yuqoriga qavariq — f'' < 0.
Asos: ikkinchi hosila belgisi.

uz: Ekstremum sharti va maksimum belgisi: $$f'(x_0)=0,\qquad f''(x_0)<0$$
ru: Условие экстремума и признак максимума: $$f'(x_0)=0,\qquad f''(x_0)<0$$
en: Extremum condition and the test for a maximum: $$f'(x_0)=0,\qquad f''(x_0)<0$$

distractors_en.B: this is the condition for a local minimum
distractors_en.E: the sign of the function value has nothing to do with an extremum

question_en: The radius of a sphere is measured with a relative error of $1\%$. The relative error in its computed volume is about
question_uz: Shar radiusi $1\%$ nisbiy xato bilan o'lchangan. Hisoblangan hajmning nisbiy xatosi taxminan qancha?
question_ru: Радиус шара измерен с относительной погрешностью $1\%$. Какова примерно относительная погрешность вычисленного объёма?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. V ∝ r³ ⇒ ΔV/V ≈ 3·Δr/r = 3%.
Asos: nisbiy xato daraja ko'rsatkichiga ko'paytiriladi.

distractors_en.C: the error for the area ($r^2$) was used

question_en: A particle has potential energy $U(x)=3x^2-12x$ (joules, meters). Its equilibrium position is at $x=$
question_uz: Zarra potensial energiyasi $U(x)=3x^2-12x$ (joul, metr). Muvozanat holati qaysi nuqtada?
question_ru: Потенциальная энергия частицы $U(x)=3x^2-12x$ (джоули, метры). В какой точке положение равновесия?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. dU/dx = 6x − 12 = 0 ⇒ x = 2 m; U'' = 6 > 0 — barqaror.
Asos: muvozanatda F = −dU/dx = 0.

distractors.E: bu $U=0$ ning ildizi (yoki hosilada $2$ ko'paytuvchi unutilgan: $3x-12=0$)

distractors_en.B: $6x-6=0$ — the constant term was taken wrongly
distractors_en.E: this is the root of $U=0$ (or the factor $2$ was dropped: $3x-12=0$)

question_en: A battery with internal resistance $r$ delivers the greatest power to an external resistor $R$ when
question_uz: Ichki qarshiligi $r$ bo'lgan batareya tashqi $R$ qarshilikka qachon eng katta quvvat beradi?
question_ru: Батарея с внутренним сопротивлением $r$ отдаёт внешнему резистору $R$ наибольшую мощность, когда
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. P = ε²R/(R+r)²; dP/dR = 0 ⇒ R = r.
Asos: ekstremum sharti (quvvat moslashuvi).

distractors.A: qisqa tutashuvda tashqi quvvat nolga teng
distractors.E: $R\to\infty$ da tok nolga intiladi va quvvat nolga teng

distractors_ru.A: при коротком замыкании внешняя мощность равна нулю
distractors_ru.E: при $R\to\infty$ ток стремится к нулю, мощность равна нулю

distractors_en.A: at short circuit the external power is zero
distractors_en.D: for $R>r$ the power is already decreasing
distractors_en.E: as $R\to\infty$ the current goes to zero and so does the power
